parameters.selection_rule: A: integeru1..384 minimizing member relative mismatch to0.5*B0, smalleru breaks ties. B/C: keepu384 only if pair within5% B0; otherwise same closest0.5 member count rule, shared B/Cu per dataset.
parameters.FFN_scope: query FFN and every retained video self FFN(4u), plus bothca FFNs(u); d384 always. All input projections/attention/LayerNorm/token/fusion layer1/layer2 kept.
parameters.path_order: Original B0 index order, no renumbering; sets match user registration.
parameters.breakdown: Disjoint query; clip/frame positional+input+retained self paths; fusion includes shared weight_token and both ca/layer1/layer2. All repeated query/input/fusion parameters counted separately per member.

paper_references.source: user request: original-paper single-model SumR, recorded verbatim before training

inclusion_decision.supersedes: uncommitted CPU-only H/T draft in <WORK>/file-89f6725c0d66fa; no old commit or GPU run
inclusion_decision.fusion_module: Keep weight_token,ca,layer1/layer2 types and dimensions; ca FFN follows registered uniform FFN ratio. Only number of ca calls changes8to4.
inclusion_decision.query_policy: Separate query encoder and input projections in each independent member; same FFN ratio applied to query and every retained video self FFN andca FFN.

C_complementarity.query_rank_agreement: fraction of test queries with exactly equal GT positive rank, using CPU member fused scores

inclusion_decision.training_time: Record exact epoch train+val wall via timing-only wrappers, excludes queue/setup/checkpoint saving/test; additionally retain original epoch-loop elapsed for historical comparability. Historical B0 elapsed includes checkpoint saves; flag this explicitly. Sum member walltimes, including simultaneous runs.
inclusion_decision.test_policy: Train on the full training set. Select checkpoints by strict improvement on the official validation split, preserve the earlier epoch on ties and use the original early stopping. Evaluate each best checkpoint on official test once. Perform only the fixed post-training compression and score averaging on CPU. Test results do not determine architectures, parameters, hyperparameters, seeds, fusion or extra runs.

training_time_note: New members exact train+val wall excludes queue/setup/checkpoint saves/test; historical B0 uses recorded epoch elapsed including checkpoint saves; DreamPRVR uses recorded train+val sum. Individual sources and definitions retained. Member walltime sums include concurrent GPU sharing, not exclusive-kernel compute.
